vsm2.17:126.3: For five-constituent becoming, etc., see §§253–54. “Unprofitable resultant eye-consciousness, etc. sometimes arise even in Brahmās when undesirable visible data, etc., come into focus” (Vism-mhṭ 604); cf. §180.
vsm2.17:129.3: This refers to the old Sinhalese commentary no longer extant.
vsm2.17:136.3: Vibh-a (Be) adds “suddhāya va javanavīthiyā” here, as in §140 below in all texts.
vsm2.17:137.2: “‘With the appearance of fire and flames, etc., in the hells’ is said owing to likeness to that; appearance of hell and fire does not itself come into focus for him then” (Vism-mhṭ 607).
